scope: Prototype-only Node VM regression; does not prove live MCP behavior

tests.name: Multiline tracker criteria transfer as whole criteria, not characters
Structured criteria and empty input normalize consistently
Agent context preserves task object, acceptance and project identifiers
Context preserves immutable resource identifiers and selected document version
Large context is explicitly bounded rather than silently implying full attachment
Captured Jenkins target excludes credential references and is independent
Removed Jenkins binding blocks replay without falling back to another available server
Replay opens original target and prior parameters even while another server is selected
Target revalidation rejects configuration changes while launch form is open
Unavailable replay target exposes blocked dialog instead of launch form
Tracker filters are isolated and restored across projects
Sprint registry retains custom and empty planned sprints within its project
Task metadata events preserve whole criteria and archive state
My open issues filter excludes completed tasks without hiding active work
